text: On November 9, 2021, later revised on September 8, 2022, the City received a Zoning By-law Amendment application for 266 - 268 Royal York Road. The application was for the construction of a mixed-use building with 37-storey and 23-storey residential towers with at-grade retail uses within the eastern portion of the site, and a self-storage warehouse building, as a future phase of development, within the western portion of the Site. The Zoning By-law Amendment application was accompanied by an Official Plan Amendment application to permit some components of the proposal, on the Core Employment Areas portion of the Site to support the mixed-use development within the Mixed -Use Areas of the Site.
